answer: RoG 一侧：作者称其提出 planning-retrieval-reasoning 框架，使 LLM 能访问最新知识，并基于图上的忠实计划进行推理 [chunk_75e927b201e488543d00046d05b35db7]；案例中 RoG 能生成忠实关系路径、从 KG 检索有效推理路径，并基于推理路径提供可解释解释 [chunk_7d9e24b10c382d84f416c7e5d421edb4]。同一案例还指出，检索到的推理路径含有噪声，但推理模块能识别正确推理路径并进行忠实推理 [chunk_7d9e24b10c382d84f416c7e5d421edb4]；这说明路径进入答案前仍要经过推理模块筛选，路径可解释不直接等于答案正确。MindMap 一侧：作者称 MindMap 利用 KG 增强 LLM 推理与透明度，使 LLM 理解 KG 输入并结合隐式与外部知识推理，还引出基于知识本体揭示推理路径的 mind map [chunk_2f4809d54362f998c1c0710e915a721b]；其实验比较了整合隐式与显式知识的能力 [chunk_c36c0155590c0da356beed7403c524ae]。不过所给证据没有具体说明 MindMap 的关系计划如何进入最终答案，流程证据不足；因此两篇如何分别保证答案正确性的机制无法按所问完整追踪。

CONCLUSION
In this paper, we propose a novel method called reasoning on graphs (RoG) that synergizes LLMs
with KGs to conduct faithful and interpretable reasoning. To alleviate the issues of hallucinations
and lack of knowledge, we present a planning-retrieval-reasoning framework, which allows LLMs
to access the latest knowledge while reasoning based on faithful plans on graphs. RoG not only en-
hances the reasoning capability of LLMs by distilling knowledge from KGs through training but also
enables seamless integration with any LLMs during inference. Extensive experiments on two bench-
mark KGQA datasets demonstrate the superiority of RoG in reasoning ability and interpretability.

We evaluate the utilization of external knowl-

answering tasks across three medical Q&A

plainCPE. These datasets cover patient-doctor
dialogues, multi-round clinical dialogues, and
multiple-choice questions from the Chinese Na-
tional Licensed Pharmacist Examination, respec-

struct two knowledge graphs (EMCKG and CM-

to medical concepts. The ExplainCPE dataset uti-
lizes CMCKG with knowledge mismatches to as-
sess the impact of incorrect retrieval knowledge
on model performance. We compare MindMap’s

soning process. To address these challenges,
we propose a novel prompting pipeline, named
MindMap, that leverages knowledge graphs
(KGs) to enhance LLMs’ inference and trans-
parency. Our method enables LLMs to com-
prehend KG inputs and infer with a combina-
tion of implicit and external knowledge. More-
over, our method elicits the mind map of LLMs,
which reveals their reasoning pathways based
on the ontology of knowledge. We evaluate our

ponents of our method. Our results demonstrate
the effectiveness and robustness of our method

codebase available at https://github.com/wyl-
